company.description: Uplight is provider of end-to-end customer-centric technology solutions. Born from the merger of Tendril and Simple Energy, and the acquisitions of FirstFuel, EEme and EnergySavvy, Uplight is the provider of end-to-end customer-centric technology solutions dedicated solely to serving the energy ecosystem.

aiResearchSummary.text: Uplight is researching systems for providing instant rebates before transactions are completed, as described in 'Energy product instant rebate engine,' which standardizes customer and rebate data from multiple utilities. The company is also developing methods for instant rebates related to demand response enrollment and clawbacks. Additionally, Uplight is working on adaptive thermal comfort learning for optimized HVAC control and setpoint adjustment-based duty cycling to reduce energy consumption. These areas reflect a focus on customer-centric energy solutions.
